author: yoloboy71
body: i was banned a few weeks ago for saying kys (even though i said jk after and it was to a friend), and i was wondering anyway i could get unbanned. i truly love this server and it was one of the servers that i only played and getting banned on it really made my minecraft experience worse. i really love this server and it would mean the world if i could have a second chance. thank you <3

replies.body:
Hello,

I'm going to have to deny this appeal based off that you have been temporarily banned for suicide encouragement before and then you received a ban for suicide encouragement yet again; since this is a just and fair ban you will need to appeal in a couple more months in order to be considered to be appealed.

-John
